detail.longDescription: Hello, fediverse. MEHO is an open-source control layer between AI agents and infrastructure — it decides what an agent may do, records every action, and stops for a human on risky steps. Born in a live VMware Cloud Foundation datacenter on bare metal, run daily with agents. Apache 2.0, self-hosted, MCP-native. Over the next six weeks we tell the whole story, two posts a week. github.com/evoila/meho https:// meho.ai/ # introduction # opensource # selfhosted # AIagents
